title: Rufat Agayev The Bad Rufat
overview: Rufat Agayev’s debut comedy special, The Bad Rufat, captures the magic of his unique journey. He’s a featured writer in the HarperCollins-published anthology Alien Nation, host of Joe Pera’s favorite NYC show, Scorpion Records Comedy Night, and has appeared on The Adam Friedland Show, Stavvy’s World, and has a taped set with Don’t Tell Comedy
